create_EncodedVideoDecord_with_audio: create an EncodedVideoDecord instance from a binary video file to decode both video frames and audio samples
create_EncodedVideoDecord_video_only: create an EncodedVideoDecord instance with decode_audio disabled to decode only video frames from an encoded file
get_clip_frames_and_audio: get a clip of video frames and audio samples between two timestamps in seconds from an EncodedVideoDecord object
review_EncodedVideoDecord_fault_toleranc: review the EncodedVideoDecord class and its fault tolerance configuration for handling corrupted video frames during decoding
summarize_EncodedVideoDecord_close: summarize the EncodedVideoDecord close method that releases the underlying Decord AVReader or VideoReader resource
